$comment: Stage 2 output, hand-authored for the POC in place of the Claude Agent SDK step. Every code anchor is checked by scripts/extract.mjs against pinned git objects. Times are seconds; narration is stubbed as captions (no TTS).
title: Litefleet: how a node says no

scenes.title: Litefleet · node components
scenes.narration: Every Litefleet node runs six responsibilities. One of them decides whether a SQL statement may run at all.
The admission engine: per-database lanes, then tenant and node limits.

steps.label: Pick read / write lane
steps.narration: acquire picks the database's read lane, or its single write lane.

steps.label: Queue ≤ 8, else 429
steps.narration: No free lane? Eight statements may wait. The ninth gets 429 tenant_busy at once.

steps.label: Tenant slot (4)
steps.narration: Next, a tenant slot: four statements per tenant across the node, inside a 250 ms wait.

steps.label: Node slot (16), else 503
steps.narration: Then a node slot: sixteen per node, or 503 node_busy, handing back what it already holds.

steps.label: Return release func
steps.narration: Success returns a release func that frees node, tenant and lane in reverse order.
